The full game is re-made from the base up to improve graphics, game engine and more. Rise through the ranks of the Mafia during the Prohibition era of organized crime. After a run-in with the mob, cab driver Tommy Angelo is thrust into a deadly underworld. Initially uneasy about falling in with the Salieri crime family, Tommy soon finds that the rewards are too big to ignore. Live the life of a Prohibition-era gangster and rise through the ranks of the Mafia in this game. The game is recreated 1930's cityscape, filled with interwar architecture, cars and culture to see, hear and interact with. Faithfully recreated, with expanded story, gameplay and original score. This is the Mafia you remembered and much more.

products.name: Mafia: The Old Country for PlayStation 5
products.description:
Mafia: The Old Country for PlayStation 5

Mafia: The Old Country for PlayStation 5 is a cinematic action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. Players step into the role of Enzo Favara, a young man escaping the sulfur mines and drawn into the violent Torrisi crime family. This prequel to the Mafia series explores loyalty, betrayal, and survival, offering a gritty look at the origins of organized crime.

Enhanced for PlayStation 5, Mafia: The Old Country delivers sharper visuals, immersive DualSense haptic feedback, and authentic period detail. Gameplay includes knife duels, stealth missions, and firefights with weapons like lupara shotguns and pistols. Players can explore Sicily through horseback riding, early automobiles, vineyards, ruins, and opera houses.

The game is available in Standard Edition with good soundtrack, and visuals. The Free Ride update adds high-stakes races, stealth challenges, first-person driving, and classic difficulty modes. With PS Plus Premium support for cloud streaming and a one-hour trial, Mafia: The Old Country PS5 game is accessible to both new players and long-time fans.

Praised for its narrative and Sicilian setting, though critiqued for repetitive combat, Mafia: The Old Country continues to expand with the upcoming Man of Honor DLC. For fans of mob dramas and cinematic storytelling, Mafia: The Old Country PlayStation 5 game is a must-play, offering an authentic journey into the roots of the Mafia.
